items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: And we had a little girl, Kyle Cook.

ctx.x: And they had all those fellas, looked like white brothers in the band, except me and the bass player, Edda. And the TV car said, what kind of band is this? A higher band? We could play it through. Who was in that band? He said, who was the fellas in that band? Who was the fellas? Them was white. Look out there, man. And Ray T. Gar, he's there too, you know, drummer. He looked like a white fella too. And we had a little girl, Kyle Cook. You know Bill, right? Yeah, yeah. We had him, myself, and Eddie. He didn't…
Which Eddie was that on bass?
